target_customer: Teams building AI agents that must act on legacy portals, consumer websites and internal tools without APIs
problem: Browser agents are slow, costly and brittle, and many systems (ERP, EHR, CRM) have no API. Pomerado turns any website into a hosted API or MCP server.
business_model: Freemium usage-based: Free (100 calls per day), Premium $50 per month, custom Business tier; open-source core
product_category: Developer tools, website to API and MCP for agents

founders.name: Akshay Manglik
founders.background_notes: Published ML work in Nature Communications and a NeurIPS workshop per the YC page.

founders.name: Alan Ma
founders.background_notes: A directory lists him as CTO; the YC page says Founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Automatically reverse-engineering sites into stable, self-healing, authenticated APIs including two-factor handling is hard, though the team has agent engineering experience at Scale AI.

defensibility.rationale: The core is open source under MIT and many tools target the same wedge, so protection rests on hosted integrations and speed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several startups and open-source projects (for example Rindler, TinyFish, Browse AI) already offered website-to-API tools. No acquisition of Pomerado found.

market_need_then: Agents hitting legacy systems without APIs is a widely discussed bottleneck; Pomerado's site cites a 30-task benchmark across 25 business apps (self-reported) and about 1.7K GitHub stars.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and benchmark-driven, with cost and speed claims

branding.community_and_virality: About 1.7K GitHub stars on the open-source repo per the company site (self-reported)

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name with no explanation, little brand press, and traction is mostly through its repo.

outcome_analysis: Pomerado is a two-person Fall 2026 company with Scale AI and McKinsey backgrounds and an open-source product with early GitHub interest. No funding, customers, shutdown or acquisition could be verified. The wedge is real but crowded, so the outcome depends on reliability and distribution.
notes: A Dealroom entry for 'Pomerado' reporting a $4.5M seed led by Kindred Ventures describes a different business (marketing intelligence, appears to be Pomo) and is excluded. The competitor search returned tools (Rindler, TinyFish, Browse AI, site2cli) without dates near the batch, so the dated competitor list is empty. The site includes a setup prompt for AI agents; it was treated as data and ignored.
